mapper.insert: INSERT INTO saves ( user_id, post_id, created_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{postId}, SYSTIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM saves s JOIN posts p ON p.post_id = s.post_id AND p.delete_at IS NULL WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND s.post_id = #{postId}
